climbs_list.name: Alto de la Venta de la Cebada

story: Numerous attacks marked the opening phase, and it took a long time before a large group of 43 riders finally broke clear. The front group split on the second climb, but the various breakaway groups came back together after the final ascent. A new nine-rider selection then escaped, including teammates Van Aert and Brennan. Van Aert attacked in the finale, with only Paret-Peintre able to follow. The pair stayed clear, before Van Aert won the sprint-à-deux.
